# WHO declared COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11, 2020 (Wednesday)
# The weekly report dated 03/11/20 is the week during which it was designated

# 5 weeks PRECEDING the pandemic week (03/11/20):

# The 5 weeks preceding that week = weekly reports from ~02/05 to ~03/04
# Specifically: 02/05, 02/12, 02/19, 02/26, 03/04
before_dates = ['02/05/20', '02/12/20', '02/19/20', '02/26/20', '03/04/20']
before_values = [-444, -549, -469, -461, -43]
print('5 weeks PRECEDING (excl pandemic week 03/11):')
for d, v in zip(before_dates, before_values):
    print(f'  {d}: {v}')
before_sum = sum(before_values)
print(f'  SUM: {before_sum}')

# 5 weeks FOLLOWING the pandemic week (03/11/20):
# Weekly reports after 03/11: 03/18, 03/25, 04/01, 04/08, 04/15
after_dates = ['03/18/20', '03/25/20', '04/01/20', '04/08/20', '04/15/20']
after_values = [-24, -100, -67, -125, -197]
print()
print('5 weeks FOLLOWING (excl pandemic week 03/11):')
for d, v in zip(after_dates, after_values):
    print(f'  {d}: {v}')
after_sum = sum(after_values)
print(f'  SUM: {after_sum}')

print()
print(f'Cumulative net options BEFORE pandemic week: {before_sum}')
print(f'Cumulative net options AFTER pandemic week: {after_sum}')
print(f'Absolute difference: |{before_sum} - {after_sum}| = {abs(before_sum - after_sum)}')
"
